en.t: “An abandoned child?” Shinichi murmured to himself,

units.source_text: “千重子，你也会觉得你自己是弃儿吗？

en.t: “Chieko, do you also feel that you yourself are an abandoned child?

units.source_text: 要是千重子是弃儿，我这号人也是弃儿啦，精神上的……

en.t: If you are an abandoned child, Chieko, then someone like me is an abandoned child too, spiritually...

units.source_text: 也许凡人都是弃儿，因为出生仿佛就是上帝把你遗弃到这个人世间来嘛。”

en.t: Perhaps all ordinary people are abandoned children, because being born is almost like God abandoning you into this human world.”
